claims: 30-second confirmation is the reported configuration, not the minimum observed across the short sweeps
Latency reports emitted command before SONIC/PD; separately retain command-ready and PD-ready
Latency configuration NVML peak is main-table memory; throughput configuration peak is reported separately
Low bounded queues change frame exposure; preserve source timestamps and interpolate the GV feature grid
The repeated source is for timing only, not action-quality evaluation
Unlimited mode preserves motion FPS=30 and uses no-drop backpressure; throughput is unique processed RGB divided by entire trial wall time
